d: Abdul El-Sayed has attacked Donald Trump’s policies, blaming the Iran war for rising US gas and grocery prices in a campaign speech ahead of Election Day. El-Sayed also criticised Trump’s tariff policies and healthcare legislation, arguing that they are adding to the cost-of-living burden. Addressing attacks on his name and faith, he said they were intended to distract voters. He described Trump as a symptom of a deeper political system shaped by billionaires, corporations and special interests. El-Sayed also spoke about corporate campaign spending, workers’ rights, healthcare, democracy…
